videos.description:
How did a quiet Dutch company in Veldhoven build the world's most inescapable monopoly? Discover the shocking physics, espionage, and geopolitical warfare behind ASML's 13.5nm Extreme Ultraviolet (EUV) machines—the only devices on Earth capable of printing advanced AI microchips.

From blasting 50,000 molten tin droplets every single second with high-powered CO2 lasers to Carl Zeiss mirrors so smooth that if scaled to the size of Germany, the highest bump would be less than a millimeter, this documentary decodes the single point of failure of the modern global economy.

00:00 - The Monopoly That Rules the Global Economy

More than 45% of all US stock trades never touch the public NYSE or NASDAQ exchange. Instead, trillions of dollars flow silently through unregulated private exchanges known as Dark Pools.

In this investigative documentary, Silicon Pulse decodes the microwave networks spanning from Chicago to New Jersey, laser transmission towers, and collocated server racks that let quantitative hedge funds execute trades in microseconds before retail investors even see the bid.
